title: Why does my roommate always leave empty milk cartons in the fridge?!
content:
I am honestly at my wits end here. For the third time this week I went to pour myself morning coffee and found a completely empty carton of oat milk sitting right on the top shelf.

Who even does that?! Just throw it in the recycling bin right next to the counter!

Has anyone successfully trained a stubborn roommate to clean up after themselves or should I just look for my own apartment when the lease ends in September?
